##  Problem 1: [Protein Mass](https://rosalind.info/problems/prtm/)


## Code

```python
from Bio.Seq import Seq

mass_table = {
    'A': 71.03711,  'C': 103.00919, 'D': 115.02694, 'E': 129.04259,
    'F': 147.06841, 'G': 57.02146,  'H': 137.05891, 'I': 113.08406,
    'K': 128.09496, 'L': 113.08406, 'M': 131.04049, 'N': 114.04293,
    'P': 97.05276,  'Q': 128.05858, 'R': 156.10111, 'S': 87.03203,
    'T': 101.04768, 'V': 99.06841,  'W': 186.07931, 'Y': 163.06333
}

protein_seq = Seq("SKADYEK")

def calculate_protein_mass(protein_sequence):
    return sum(mass_table.get(aa, 0) for aa in protein_sequence)

print(f"{calculate_protein_mass(protein_seq):.3f}")


## Problem 2: [RNA → Protein](https://rosalind.info/problems/prot/)

## Code

```python
from Bio.Seq import Seq

seq = Seq("AUGGCCAUGGCGCCCAGAACUGAGAUCAAUAGUACCCGUAUUAACGGGUGA")
protein = seq.translate(table=1, to_stop=True)

print(protein)
```

## Problem 3: [Hamming Distance](https://rosalind.info/problems/hamm/)


## Code

```python
String1 = "GAGCCTACTAACGGGAT"
String2 = "CATCGTAATGACGGCCT"

zip_iterator = zip(String1, String2)
hamming_distance = 0

for a, b in zip_iterator:
    if a != b:
        hamming_distance += 1

print(hamming_distance)
```

## Problem 4: [GC Content](https://rosalind.info/problems/gc/)

## Code

```python
from Bio.Seq import Seq
from Bio import SeqIO
from Bio.SeqUtils import gc_fraction

Highest_GC_content = 0
Highest_ID = ""

record = SeqIO.parse("rosalind_gc.fasta", "fasta")

for seq_record in record:
    seq = seq_record.seq
    gc_content = gc_fraction(seq)
    if gc_content > Highest_GC_content:
        Highest_GC_content = gc_content
        Highest_ID = seq_record.id

print(f"{Highest_ID}\n{Highest_GC_content:.8f}")
```
